facts.text: Leo wants his order right this time.
facts.why: In the same scene Leo rants about getting short-changed at drive-throughs and insists on the counter, so wanting his order right fits.
Rianne's TV commercial is a real scene (Murtaugh's family watches it at eight o'clock), so a TV ad dish name is a fair nod.

facts.text: Arjen Rudd's drink, before his immunity is revoked.
facts.why: Rudd's immunity is revoked at the end, but no source shows brandy and Coke as his drink.

vibe.verdict: The boat on the lawn and the South African dishes are a good fit, but Leo's food scenes are guesses and the big gags are missing.
